mentions.name: AI-native data authoring/exploration experience (Trilogy spike)
mentions.description: A planned spike on a pure AI-native data authoring and exploration experience, exploring agent-driven data consumption at both CLI and UI layers, built separately so it does not affect the core Trilogy product.
mentions.source_excerpt: so this month going to do a spike on a new pure AI native data authoring/exploration experience to see where that can go without messing with the core product, at both CLI/UI layers. Data consumption is (un?)fortunately a pretty perfect fit for the agent strengths with the right harness.
